en.title: Recover an Array from Prefix XORs
en.description:
pref[i] is the XOR of elements 0 through i of the original array. Return the original array.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; missing numeric ranges are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N (1..100000), and the second line contains N values pref[i] (0..10⁹). Recovered values may exceed 10⁹ but are less than 2³⁰.
en.explanation: Example 1: the elements are 2, 0, 7, 3. Example 2: the only element is 0. Example 3: the prefix XORs of the original array 7, 7, 7 are 7, 0, 7.
hints: The first element equals pref[0], and every other element is the XOR of two adjacent prefixes.
